description: Desktop subtitle editor with local Whisper transcription. Tauri 2.0 app: React/TypeScript frontend + Rust backend, communicating via Tauri IPC. All file/subprocess/network work happens in Rust; the webview has no shell/fs permissions.

nodes.label: OpenView
nodes.description: Landing / file-open screen. Drag & drop, recent files. Routes files via src/lib/file-routing.ts (video vs subtitle). Guarded by confirmDiscardIfDirty (src/lib/unsaved-guard.ts) before any document swap.

nodes.label: Player
nodes.description: HTML5 video player in WKWebView. Plays previewPath (proxy) when set, otherwise the original file. Synced with playerStore playhead; renders styled caption overlay.

nodes.label: SubtitleEditor
nodes.description: Main subtitle list editor (SubtitleRow per cue). Edit text/timing, split, merge. Keyboard shortcuts via src/lib/keyboard-shortcuts.ts.

nodes.label: TranscriptionPanel
nodes.description: Whisper model picker, model download progress, start/cancel transcription.

nodes.label: TranslationPanel
nodes.description: Translation UI: engine choice (Gemini / Claude / local TranslateGemma), language, progress, cancel. CompareView.tsx shows source-vs-translation diff (src/lib/diff.ts).

nodes.label: StylePanel
nodes.description: Caption styling UI: one global CaptionStyle + CaptionAnimation (src/types/captionStyle.ts). FontPicker uses backend font enumeration; presets in src/lib/caption-presets.ts.

nodes.label: VideoExportModal
nodes.description: MP4 burn-in export dialog: output path (hard-guarded to never equal the source), progress, cancel.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.description: App settings incl. API key entry. Keys are sent over IPC once to be stored; frontend afterwards only sees presence flags (hasGeminiKey / hasClaudeKey).

nodes.label: subtitleStore
nodes.description: Zustand store: subtitle cues, 50-item undo/redo stack, dirty flag (drives unsaved-changes guard and native close guard in lib.rs).

nodes.label: playerStore
nodes.description: Zustand store: playhead position, filePath (original, used for transcription + burn-in) and previewPath (display-only proxy).

nodes.label: styleStore
nodes.description: Zustand store for the global CaptionStyle/CaptionAnimation. Persisted to localStorage (separate key from settings).

nodes.label: settingsStore
nodes.description: Zustand store persisted to localStorage key 'transcriptpro-settings'. Also: versionStore, recentFilesStore, notifyStore, logStore, updateStore, onboardingStore.

nodes.label: versionStore
nodes.description: Version-history snapshots of the subtitle document; persisted via file_io save_version_history/load_version_history.

nodes.label: subtitle-ops
nodes.description: Pure subtitle operations: split, merge, reindex. Time conversion in src/lib/time-format.ts.

nodes.label: caption-style libs
nodes.description: Serialization & measurement helpers for caption styling and animation (caption-style.ts, caption-animation.ts, caption-presets.ts).

nodes.label: tauri-commands.ts
nodes.description: Single IPC gateway: typed wrappers around every Tauri invoke(). All backend calls in the app go through this module. Backend events (progress, completion) come back as Tauri events.

nodes.label: file_io.rs
nodes.description: import_srt, export_srt/word_srt/txt/vtt/ass, preview_export, save/load_version_history. Only SRT has an importer; VTT/ASS are export-only (don't count as project save).

nodes.label: audio.rs
nodes.description: extract_audio / cancel_audio_extraction — ffmpeg wrapper extracting audio (temp transcriptpro_audio_*.wav) for Whisper.

nodes.label: transcribe.rs
nodes.description: list_models, download_model, transcribe_audio, cancel_transcription. Whisper.cpp model management (models in Tauri app-data dir) and transcription with progress events.

nodes.label: preview.rs
nodes.description: prepare_preview / cancel_preview. Probes the source; for heavy (>1920px) or rotation-flagged video, transcodes a 720p rotation-baked proxy (tpro_proxy_*) for display only. Original filePath stays untouched.

nodes.label: video_export.rs
nodes.description: export_video / cancel_video_export. ffmpeg burn-in of styled/animated subtitles (over generated ASS) into MP4. Re-entrancy guard, cancel support, hard guard output != source.

nodes.label: translate.rs
nodes.description: translate_subtitles / cancel_translation. Orchestrates Gemini / Claude / local engine; network via reqwest from Rust (not gated by webview CSP).

nodes.label: local_model.rs
nodes.description: local_model_status, download_local_model, cancel_local_model_download. Downloads the TranslateGemma 4B GGUF (SHA-256 pinned) into app-data.

nodes.label: keys.rs
nodes.description: set/delete/has_api_key, api_key_saved_at. Master key in OS keychain (service com.transcriptpro.app, account master-key); API keys AES-GCM-encrypted in app-data keys.enc.json. Keys never cross IPC to the webview.

nodes.label: fonts.rs
nodes.description: list_system_fonts — system font enumeration via fontdb, on spawn_blocking, for the FontPicker.

nodes.label: subtitle formats
nodes.description: Domain types (types.rs) and per-format parsers/serializers: srt.rs (import+export), vtt.rs and ass.rs (export-only), style.rs (ASS styling).

nodes.label: translation engines
nodes.description: gemini.rs, claude.rs (cloud, reqwest), local.rs (drives the llama-server sidecar; hand-rolled Gemma prompt turns because the GGUF chat template doesn't parse — hence --no-jinja).

nodes.label: ffmpeg
nodes.description: Used for: audio extraction (WAV for Whisper), 720p preview-proxy transcode, MP4 subtitle burn-in.

nodes.label: whisper.cpp
nodes.description: Local Whisper transcription. GGML models downloaded to the Tauri app-data models dir (~/.config/transcriptpro/models on macOS/Linux).

nodes.label: llama-server sidecar
nodes.description: Static llama.cpp server build (pinned tag), spawned as a Tauri sidecar with --no-jinja, serving TranslateGemma 4B for local translation.

nodes.label: Gemini API
nodes.description: Cloud translation provider, called from Rust via reqwest. Domain listed in CSP connect-src (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json).

nodes.label: Anthropic API
nodes.description: Cloud translation provider (Claude), called from Rust via reqwest.

nodes.label: OS keychain
nodes.description: Single master-key entry (service com.transcriptpro.app). Electron-safeStorage pattern: one keychain item, at most one macOS ACL prompt per run.

nodes.label: Filesystem / app-data
nodes.description: SRT/VTT/ASS/TXT files, version history, Whisper models, TranslateGemma GGUF, keys.enc.json, temp files (transcriptpro_audio_*, tpro_burn_*, tpro_proxy_* — swept by cleanup_stale_temp in lib.rs on startup).

nodes.label: localStorage
nodes.description: WebView localStorage: 'transcriptpro-settings' (settingsStore) + a separate key for styleStore. Never contains API keys.

flows.name: Open video → Whisper transcription
flows.description: User opens a video; audio is extracted with ffmpeg and transcribed locally with whisper.cpp; segments land in the editor.

steps.text: User drops/opens a media file. file-routing.ts classifies it as video; unsaved-guard runs if the document is dirty.
File path is handed to the IPC layer; playerStore.filePath is set to the ORIGINAL file.
invoke extract_audio(filePath).
ffmpeg extracts a temp WAV (transcriptpro_audio_*.wav) suitable for Whisper.
invoke transcribe_audio with the selected Whisper model (downloaded to app-data if missing via download_model).
whisper.cpp runs on the WAV; progress streams back as Tauri events.
Resulting segments are pushed into subtitleStore; the editor renders the cue list.

flows.name: Video preview proxy
flows.description: Heavy or rotated video is transcoded to a 720p display proxy so WKWebView can play it. Transcription and burn-in always use the original file.

steps.text: Video is opened; original path stored as playerStore.filePath.
invoke prepare_preview — preview.rs probes resolution/rotation of the source.
If >1920px wide or rotation-flagged: ffmpeg transcodes a lightweight 720p rotation-baked proxy (tpro_proxy_*). Otherwise no proxy is made.
previewPath is set in playerStore (display-only; filePath stays the original).
Player plays previewPath ?? filePath; playhead syncs back to playerStore.

flows.name: Edit subtitles (undo / versions)
flows.description: Editing goes through pure ops into subtitleStore (undo/redo + dirty flag); snapshots persist via version history.

steps.text: User edits text/timing or triggers split/merge on a SubtitleRow.
Structural changes run through pure functions in subtitle-ops.ts (split, merge, reindex).
New cue state is committed to subtitleStore: pushed onto the 50-item undo stack, dirty=true.
versionStore takes document snapshots for version history.
save_version_history persists snapshots via file_io.rs to app-data.

flows.name: Import / export subtitle files
flows.description: SRT import and SRT/VTT/ASS/TXT export via file_io.rs and the per-format serializers. Only SRT save clears the dirty flag.

steps.text: Import: an .srt file is opened (only SRT has an importer — VTT/ASS are export-only).
invoke import_srt / export_srt / export_vtt / export_ass / export_txt.
file_io.rs parses or serializes via src-tauri/src/subtitle/ (srt.rs, vtt.rs, ass.rs, style.rs).
File is read/written on disk. On SRT save, subtitleStore.dirty is cleared; VTT/ASS export does NOT count as a project save.

flows.name: Cloud translation (Gemini / Claude)
flows.description: translate.rs reads the decrypted API key backend-side and calls the provider via reqwest — the key never crosses IPC to the webview.

steps.text: User picks engine + target language in TranslationPanel and starts translation.
invoke translate_subtitles(engine, cues, targetLang).
translate.rs obtains the decrypted API key from the keys module (backend-side only).
Dispatch to gemini.rs or claude.rs — cues are batched into prompts.
HTTP calls to the provider via reqwest (Rust-side, so not gated by webview CSP). Progress + cancel supported.
Translated cues stream back into subtitleStore; CompareView shows a source-vs-translation diff.

flows.name: Local translation (TranslateGemma + llama-server)
flows.description: Offline translation: a SHA-256-pinned GGUF served by a static llama-server sidecar; prompts are hand-rolled Gemma turns (--no-jinja).

steps.text: First use: invoke download_local_model — TranslateGemma 4B GGUF, SHA-256 pinned.
GGUF is downloaded into app-data (resumable, cancellable).
invoke translate_subtitles with engine=local.
translation/local.rs takes over — the local engine.
It spawns/talks to the static llama-server sidecar (pinned llama.cpp tag, --no-jinja; Gemma turns are hand-rolled because the GGUF chat template doesn't parse).
Translated cues are merged into subtitleStore.

flows.name: MP4 export (subtitle burn-in)
flows.description: Styled/animated captions are serialized to ASS and burned into an MP4 with ffmpeg — always from the ORIGINAL source, never the preview proxy.

steps.text: VideoExportModal reads the global CaptionStyle/CaptionAnimation from styleStore.
caption-style libs serialize style + animation parameters for the backend.
User confirms output path; frontend gates export; hard guard: output must differ from the source file.
invoke export_video — re-entrancy guard ensures only one export at a time.
video_export.rs generates the styled/animated ASS via the subtitle serializers.
ffmpeg burns the ASS into the MP4 (temp dir tpro_burn_*), using playerStore.filePath — the original, not the proxy. Progress events + cancel.

flows.name: API key storage
flows.description: Electron-safeStorage pattern: one master key in the OS keychain, API keys AES-GCM-encrypted in app-data. The webview only ever sees presence flags.

steps.text: User pastes a Gemini/Claude key in Settings; invoke set_api_key (the only moment a key crosses IPC, inbound).
keys.rs receives the key.
A single random master key lives in the OS keychain (service com.transcriptpro.app, account master-key) — at most one macOS ACL prompt per run.
The API key is AES-GCM-encrypted with the master key and written to app-data keys.enc.json.
Frontend only tracks presence flags (hasGeminiKey/hasClaudeKey) via has_api_key — actual keys never return to the webview and are never in localStorage.
